newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bahia state plans $200 mln bond - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bahia state plans $200 mln bond - report.

text.p: Brazil's Bahia state government plans to launch a $200 million Eurobond by April next year, financial newspaper Gazeta Mercantil reported.
The issue will be divided in two tranches of $100 million and it will be backed up by the state's tax revenues, Gazeta said, quoting Alberico Mascarenhas, Bahia state's sub-secretary of Finance.
The paper did not say what the maturity period of the bond would be and state officials were not immediately available for comment.
Gazeta said the state would only hire a bank to coordinate the issue after receiving authorization from the state's Legislative Assembly next month.
Proceeds from the issue will be invested in social programs, it said.
